stages.name: Blend the sky in the window
steps: Inside the outlined area. Its top is at the top edge, and its left side is at the left edge; it's about 1 1/4 in wide and 1 3/4 in tall.
Paints, top to bottom: Pale sky blue, then Warm white.
Mix enough Warm white for this step and steps 5, 15 and 21; cover it between them.
Brush: 3/4 inch wash brush. Load: Creamy paint. An even coat.
Start with the darkest color and stroke side to side. Without rinsing, pick up the next lighter color and paint below it. Then stroke back up over the join several times.
It should leave smooth bands of color, with a soft join where two wet colors meet.
Watch out: Blending after the paint has started to drag. Acrylic sets in minutes, and scrubbing setting paint lifts it and leaves streaks. Fix: stop as soon as it drags.
Let it dry, then blend a new thin layer on top.

technique_picks.technique_why: A soft, simple indoor scene of big shapes (wall, window, sill, blanket, cat) that paints naturally back to front on white canvas, with the cat built from an oval and a circle the way a beginner tutorial does it.

parts.name: The sky through the window
parts.why: A pale, soft gradient behind the leaves, blended wet in one go.

parts.name: The leaves outside the window
parts.why: A loose mass of green leaves, dabbed dark then light.

parts.name: The blue wall
parts.why: A plain background that goes from deeper blue by the window to a softer blue, blended wet; sky-blend is the closest element for a smooth wall.

parts.name: The white window frame
parts.why: Straight cream-white bars built from rectangles, then a lavender shadow side.

parts.name: The frame's shadows
parts.why: Straight cream-white bars built from rectangles, then a lavender shadow side.

parts.name: The wooden windowsill
parts.why: A long warm-brown slab built from a rectangle top and a front edge, then shaded and given its sunny patch.

parts.name: The sill's shadow and sunlight
parts.why: A long warm-brown slab built from a rectangle top and a front edge, then shaded and given its sunny patch.

parts.name: The yellow knit blanket
parts.why: A folded roll of knit built from pieces; its knit loops are short press-and-lift marks, dark then light. shaped-object has no knit step of its own, so the shading and light passes carry the loops.
